scope: Advice only. No production source, test source, real Vault, operator receipt, Git, network or human-gate mutation was performed.

baseline.head: c32e68d08a142d5a5559ce717ff397f9b27f55d1
baseline.compatibility_rule: Keep base-catalog-v1 and search-catalog-v1 profiles, schemas, SQL, column meanings and legacy index/status/query behavior unchanged. source-catalog-v1 is a separate closed successor projection.

profile_and_material.canonical_bytes: JCS JSON UTF-8, no BOM, one LF terminator; every embedded byte payload is base64url without padding and is hashed separately
profile_and_material.ordering: Every group is sorted by its declared stable key encoded as UTF-8 bytes; duplicate keys refuse. Group order is the order above. Nested arrays use explicit ordinal fields and are sorted by (owner identity, ordinal).
profile_and_material.digest_domain: catalog_sha256 = SHA-256(ASCII('video-paper-wiki.source-catalog-v1\0') || canonical root with catalog_sha256 omitted); basis and generation digests include complete path/hash/size/mode inventory and all rows, never a truncated projection.
profile_and_material.limit_rule: Refuse with SOURCE_CATALOG_LIMIT before omission, truncation or partial artifact creation. Limits must be part of the profile digest.

source_and_coverage_semantics: Project every validated registration and association, including a registered source with no paper owner and every captured/parser artifact that has no canonical paper. Use state=registered_unclaimed, captured_uncovered, or orphan_invalid with a typed reason; never silently drop it.

Keep selected_display_association as a paper-level derived head. Keep citation_association_id on each evidence row. A historical citation is valid when its exact association, registration proof, raw bytes and locator data remain valid, even when display selection changes or rolls back.

Source registration rows are historical evidence, not authorization. Preserve receipt path, receipt hash, first registration ledger hash and source-ledger identity. Do not mint a new receipt or modify the Vault while building the cache.

For Markdown, resolve through decode_markdown_locator and resolve_markdown_locator, returning exact Unicode excerpt, charspan, page anchor, excerpt hash, source_id and association reference. For legacy PDF/code, use retained parser/manifest/capture locators; if exact text cannot be reconstructed, return UNSUPPORTED_LEGACY_RESOLUTION with no fabricated excerpt.

rules: ABSENT means the fixed cache slot is absent and the retained source basis was safely inspected; it is not a Vault error.
CURRENT requires reconstruction from one retained snapshot and exact catalog digest equality. A caller-supplied self-consistent descriptor is insufficient.
STALE means a previously valid cache no longer matches basis, generation material, profile/resources, runtime/dependency/tokenizer or complete rows.
CONFLICT is reserved for fixed-slot identity replacement, symlink/hardlink/non-regular file, parent replacement or differing bytes at an existing slot.
UNCOVERED is evidence-derived coverage state for a valid registered/captured object without canonical paper or citation owner; it is not a cache failure.
status_envelope.legacy_boundary: Legacy index.status and collector retain SOURCE_PROFILE_REQUIRED (exit 75) for source-aware inputs. Source-catalog status uses its own envelope and never rewrites that code to CATALOG_STALE.

lookup_and_query.ranking: Normalize/tokenize using a frozen source-catalog tokenizer profile; rank by descending exact score, then kind rank, stable identity UTF-8 bytes, and locator ordinal. Freeze score representation and tie behavior in the profile. Do not call or alter legacy rank_hits semantics.
lookup_and_query.filters: accepted-only evaluates the validated terminal assessment head and excludes provisional model/system claims; lifecycle filters evaluate the owning paper/repository reference. Caller-provided assessment fields never promote a claim.
lookup_and_query.validation: Query and lookup reconstruct or verify the complete current catalog in the same retained session, validate catalog_sha256 and basis before returning, and refuse an unknown profile, stale generation, partial rows or unsupported limit.

rules: Resolve against the citation's association_id and exact retained bytes. selected display association is informational and cannot determine citation freshness.
Markdown returns Unicode charspan and exact excerpt only after observation interval, source hash, page anchor and excerpt hash all validate.

Legacy PDF/code returns exact established page/line/manifest locator when available. Otherwise return UNSUPPORTED_LEGACY_RESOLUTION with reason=legacy_locator_not_reconstructable; never return guessed text.
Missing valid source material is UNCOVERED or a typed error according to the row state, never an empty successful excerpt.

fixed_slot_state_machine.create: Retain batch parent and slot parent descriptors; create one private regular file atomically only from ABSENT. Verify complete bytes and named edges before success.
fixed_slot_state_machine.reuse: PRESENT with byte-identical canonical bytes and unchanged retained parent/slot identity returns reused/current.
fixed_slot_state_machine.conflict: PRESENT with differing bytes, path replacement, symlink, hardlink, non-regular file, vanished file, parent replacement or unsafe permission refuses with CATALOG_SLOT_CONFLICT/CATALOG_STALE according to frozen precedence.
fixed_slot_state_machine.failure_finalizer: On every success and exception, verify root, every named parent, fixed slot edge, complete inventory and original error precedence. A failed enumeration must not skip the final complete-set check; preserve the original typed error unless the safety check has higher frozen precedence.

status_error_translation.legacy_translation_rule: Do not pass source-aware errors through legacy catalog_status's catch-all ContractError-to-CATALOG_STALE adapter. Preserve SOURCE_PROFILE_REQUIRED at the legacy boundary and use source-catalog codes in the new boundary.

recommended_test_matrix.case: Empty synthetic Vault with genesis receipt and no papers/sources
recommended_test_matrix.assert: Deterministic zero-row catalog, CURRENT after create, no hidden taxonomy or orphan rows, stable digest across repeated build.

recommended_test_matrix.case: Fully rendered legacy paper/repository and old PDF/code artifacts
recommended_test_matrix.assert: All legacy rows retained; display fields nullable; exact locator resolution or explicit unsupported result; legacy index.status still returns SOURCE_PROFILE_REQUIRED for source-aware input.

recommended_test_matrix.case: Markdown v2 plus legacy records and mixed evidence
recommended_test_matrix.assert: Association and observation rows bind exact bytes; Unicode span round-trip; compiled pages and complete source coverage are closed.

recommended_test_matrix.case: Registered source without paper, captured artifact without canonical owner, and orphan parser artifact
recommended_test_matrix.assert: Visible registered_unclaimed/captured_uncovered/orphan_invalid coverage rows with reason and stable identity; no silent filtering.

recommended_test_matrix.case: Select association A, cite historical B, then rollback display to C
recommended_test_matrix.assert: display_association_id changes while citation_association_id remains B and resolves against B; stale only after B bytes/history are actually unavailable or changed.

recommended_test_matrix.case: Assessment forks, stale terminal heads, accepted provisional model claim, lifecycle retirement
recommended_test_matrix.assert: Terminal validated head controls filters; accepted-only excludes provisional/model claims; actor/event IDs and review dates are preserved.

recommended_test_matrix.case: Partial catalog, invented excerpt, changed row, self-consistent descriptor hashes, unknown semantic path
recommended_test_matrix.assert: Reconstruction from retained bytes refuses with typed stale/input error; supplied hashes cannot authorize omission or invention.

recommended_test_matrix.case: Change head, receipt, historical snapshot, profile/resource, compiler/query byte, dependency/tokenizer/runtime
recommended_test_matrix.assert: Prior cache becomes STALE and status/query/resolve refuse until rebuilt; unchanged basis remains byte-stable.

recommended_test_matrix.case: Absent create, identical reuse, differing bytes, parent replacement, unlink/recreate, symlink, hardlink, permission and exception paths
recommended_test_matrix.assert: One retained session detects every replacement; no arbitrary output path; original typed failure is preserved and final complete-set/edge verification always runs.

recommended_test_matrix.case: Exact identity/title lookup, claim/source-excerpt lexical ranking, closed filters, limits and cursor ties
recommended_test_matrix.assert: Frozen tokenizer/score/tie order; results carry catalog generation/basis; legacy query output remains unchanged.

recommended_test_matrix.case: Existing synthetic backup followed by isolated restore with unchanged runtime/profile
recommended_test_matrix.assert: Restored retained source state rebuilds the same canonical catalog digest and rows; no real Vault or operator gate is touched.

implementation_boundary.allowed: This artifact records independent contract advice and a test matrix only.
